prerequisites: General requirements for access to the degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the concept of a company, types of companies, and the environment in which it operates.
Be able to understand the different subsystems that integrate the company.
Understand the principles of business organization and management.

syllabus_topics: Functioning of economic activity and types of markets
Concept and objectives of the company
Types of companies: economic, organizational and legal criteria
Asset and results analysis for decision making
Valuation of investment and financing projects
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as: FINAL GRADE = EX.ORD + P1 + P2 + P3 + P. To pass, a minimum of 40% (2.6 points) is required in the final exam (EX.ORD) and a minimum of 1.4 points (40%) in the sum of P1, P2, P3, and P. The overall final grade must be at least 5 points. If the final grade is above 5 points but a minimum in any component is not met, the final grade will be 4 points (fail). In extraordinary calls, grades for EX.ORD or P1+P2+P3+P may be retained if the minimums were met in the ordinary call; otherwise, corresponding re-exams (EX.EXTR and/or EX.PR) must be taken, each with a 40% minimum.
